name: Business Flex Credit
description: A fictional conventional revolving credit line for short business cash gaps.
key_features: Draw and repay funds within an agreed limit.
Conventional interest applies to the amount drawn.
benefits: Can cover a temporary mismatch between receipts and operating payments.
limitations: The business must be able to repay each draw from expected receipts.
Approval and an available limit are required before drawing.
eligibility_requirements: Established, registered business with a record of regular transactions.
Business financial statements and a successful credit assessment.
suitable_use_cases: Short-term operating payments where receipts are reasonably predictable and interest is acceptable.
unsuitable_use_cases: Persistent losses or long-term expansion funding.

name: Islamic Trade Finance
description: A fictional Sharia-compliant facility for a documented business purchase of eligible goods.
key_features: The provider buys approved goods from the supplier and resells them to the business at an agreed price payable over time.
The sale price and payment schedule are disclosed upfront.
benefits: Helps an eligible business spread the cost of a specific inventory purchase.
limitations: Finance is tied to an approved purchase and is subject to a transaction review.
It does not provide cash against invoices already issued to customers.
eligibility_requirements: Registered business, supplier quotation or purchase order, and eligible goods.
Credit and Sharia-compliance approval for the proposed transaction.
suitable_use_cases: Documented inventory purchases where the business needs Sharia-compliant financing.
unsuitable_use_cases: Payroll, existing bills unrelated to a new purchase, or unrestricted working capital.

name: Business Cash Management
description: A fictional service for monitoring business balances, collections, and upcoming payments.
key_features: Track overdue invoices and tag receipts against invoices.
Schedule supplier payments and view projected balances.
benefits: Helps a business follow up on late payments and spot funding gaps before payments fall due.
limitations: Provides no funding or guarantee of collection.
Projections depend on the accuracy of invoice and payment information.
eligibility_requirements: Registered business with a compatible business transaction account and an authorized account operator.
suitable_use_cases: Businesses with recurring supplier payments and variable collection dates.
unsuitable_use_cases: A business seeking immediate funding or a personal account for household expenses.

name: Goal Saver Account
description: A fictional personal savings account for building toward a planned expense.
key_features: Set a target amount and date for a savings goal.
Schedule transfers that can be adjusted or paused.
benefits: Keeps planned savings separate and shows progress toward the target.
limitations: Early withdrawals take several business days and may forfeit a goal bonus.
The account does not support day-to-day purchases.
eligibility_requirements: Adult personal customer with verified identification and a linked everyday account for transfers.
suitable_use_cases: Saving for a planned purchase, course, or other dated goal with a separate emergency reserve.
unsuitable_use_cases: Emergency funds that need same-day access or money reserved for upcoming bills.

name: Everyday Access Account
description: A fictional personal transaction account for salary, bills, and readily available reserves.
key_features: Supports salary deposits, card payments, and transfers.
Offers an instant-access space for setting aside emergency money.
benefits: Lets customers access their own funds when an unplanned expense arises.
limitations: Has no goal bonus or withdrawal friction to encourage saving.
Card and transfer limits may apply.
eligibility_requirements: Adult personal customer with verified identification.
suitable_use_cases: Routine expenses, irregular bills, and emergency savings that must be available quickly.
unsuitable_use_cases: Business payment processing or customers primarily seeking a structured goal plan with a bonus.
